ALGER — L'Algérie a été désignée pour ac: ALGIERS — Algeria has been designated to host the Information Society Summit (WSIS) in 2026. This decision was made official by the International Telecommunications Union (ITU).
L'Algérie vient d'obtenir l'organisation: Algeria has just obtained the organization of the Information Society Summit (WSIS) 2026. This recognition was announced by the International Telecommunications Union (ITU), a specialized body of the United Nations. The choice of Algeria is part of the country's efforts to strengthen its position on the international information and communication technology scene.
Le ministère des Postes et Télécommunica: The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications welcomed this announcement, emphasizing the importance of this qualification for the Algerian ICT sector. A working meeting will soon be organized to prepare for the event, according to information relayed by Algérie Télécom on its social networks.
Les autorités algériennes ont déjà entam: The Algerian authorities have already taken steps to guarantee the success of this event. A dedicated team will be set up to coordinate the necessary actions. The objective is to make this event a development lever for the Algerian digital sector.
Les détails pratiques, notamment les dat: Practical details, including the exact dates and location of the event, will be communicated later by the organizers.
